scope: Official TRAIN1281 only; existing52 video groups; no VAL/TEST numerical inputs or labels.
estimand: Paired out-of-video squared prediction-error changes for a prespecified finite ridge estimator when adding raw audio/visual summaries to a fixed text and sequence-length baseline.

features.text: 256 signed SHA256 word-hash bag dimensions normalized by word count, plus log1p(word count); fixed casefold and seed128 namespace; no vocabulary fit or pretrained encoder.
features.audio: 74 per-example means +74 population standard deviations +1 nonfinite fraction; nonfinite raw entries replaced by0 before summary.
features.visual: 47 per-example means +47 population standard deviations +1 nonfinite fraction; nonfinite raw entries replaced by0 before summary.

estimator: Each outer fit fold alone fits feature mean/std and target intercept. Constant channels masked. Ridge minimizes mean squared error + lambda1 squared coefficient norm; intercept unpenalized. No hyperparameter search or inner tuning.
outputs_before_metrics: Original fixed fold/row IDs and raw input identity receipts
Per-row out-of-fold predictions for all four prespecified paths
Fit-fold scaler and coefficient states with exact fit/held row ID hashes
Complete small output archive with SHA/CRC/unique/member receipts
reporting: Pooled row-weighted squared error and paired per-video mean squared-error differences for all52 videos; no significance/stability or information decomposition claim.
interpretation_limits: Finite estimator predictive accessibility only, not conditional MI, PID redundancy/synergy, Bayes ceiling, causality, or independent message contribution.
